name: California Burritos
notes: Router's fetch-failed was transient (Wi-Fi); a retry succeeded and the site is up. Restaurant's own /menu page links to three 'Menu TV' PDFs (1, 2, 3) that appear to be rotating in-store TV display panels, not a single document. Panels 1 and 3 have extractable text (pdftotext -raw) and are captured here in full: Breakfast Burritos, Breakfast Specials, Healthy Options, Burritos, Enchiladas, Tostadas, Roll Tacos (panel 1); Salads, Chimichanga, Combination Plates, Sandwiches, Desserts, Beverages (panel 3). Panel 2 (Menu TV-2) is image-only (pdftotext yields 1 byte) and its embedded JPEGs came out corrupted from probe/extract_pdf_images.js (invalid JPEG structure, 'two SOI markers') so it could not be read visually -- this is a tooling limit, not a guess. Standalone a-la-carte tacos (as opposed to rolled tacos and taco-combo-plate items) do not appear on panels 1 or 3 and may be on the unreadable panel 2; flagging this as a possible core-section gap rather than asserting the menu is complete. One pdftotext -raw block (the 11 Breakfast Burrito items) had its prices extracted as a separate block above the item names rather than same-line; the block-order pairing was cross-checked against pdftotext -layout output, which showed matching prices for each item in the same position, before being trusted. All other pairings are same-line in the raw text. Markup test not applicable (first-party restaurant PDF, not a delivery platform).

name: Dini's By The Sea
notes: Restaurant's own domain serves a SpotHopper menu widget directly (not the tmt.spotapps.co iframe the router flagged), server-rendered HTML with class food-item-holder/food-price -- readable by plain curl, no browser needed. The page embeds SIX menu tabs in one document (all present in the DOM, toggled by JS, so nothing was missed): Brunch (the fullest all-day menu: Breakfast, Apps, Flatbreads, Salads, Shellfish, Sandwiches, Land & Sea), Dine (a dinner-hours subset of the same dishes at matching prices, plus one unique entree, Prime Rib, spelled 'Pime Rib' on the site itself), Sweet Endings (desserts, exact duplicate of Dine's Desserts subsection -- dropped as a duplicate, not filed twice), Kids Menu (its own Breakfast and Lunch-or-Dinner subsections), Happy Hour (a standing discounted menu for a subset of apps/flatbreads/shellfish -- kept as its own 'Happy Hour' section, not merged into the regular prices, since the same dishes carry two different real prices depending on which menu they are ordered from), and Dini's After Dark (mostly unpriced drink categories -- Happy Hour Beers/Cocktails/Wine and Dini's After Dark Beer/Cocktails/Wine were dropped with no price shown; only 'Dini's After Dark Beer & Shot' at $10.00 had one). 'Catch of the Day' (both a Land & Sea entry and a footnoted add-on) is Market Price only and was dropped, not estimated. New England Clam Chowder is priced by size (Cup $8.00 / Bowl $12.00 / Bread Bowl $17.00) -- all three sizes are real, read prices, not derived. Markup test not applicable (first-party site, not a delivery platform); 80 of 81 prices are whole-dollar, one is $10.50, consistent with a normally-priced sit-down restaurant.
